rules.old:
LogPrintf("FATAL: wallet notification worker failed; shutting "
                      "down. The wallet rescans from its last flushed best "
                      "block on restart.\n")
rules.replacement: LogInfoEvent(BCLog::ALL, "wallet_notification_worker_failed", "FATAL: wallet notification worker failed; shutting down. The wallet rescans from its last flushed best block on restart.")

reviewed_input.format: FATAL: wallet notification worker failed; shutting down. The wallet rescans from its last flushed best block on restart.

rules.review_note: Preserve Info despite FATAL/exception words, callback catch/rethrow behavior, m_failed ordering, shutdown request, queue/flush accounting and rescan promises. No transaction/wallet serialization or worker-recovery fix. Static failure text fits the bounded record; arbitrary exception text uses existing bounded Error contract and truncation flag. Rare actual callback/failure paths not newly injected.
